about_the_game:
Can you outsmart chaos with perfect unit merges?

ChanceLot TD: Merge Wars is a unique tactical tower defense game where strategy, luck, and the art of merging units collide. Join exciting battles and team up with a friend or a random opponent to fend off waves of enemies together!

  • Team Up to Defend Against Relentless Waves

    Play cooperatively with a friend or a random ally as you defend your core against endless waves of increasingly powerful enemies. Coordination and timing are key to survival.

  • Merge Units Mid-Battle for Tactical Advantage

    Combine identical units directly on the battlefield to unlock stronger forms with new abilities. Every merge opens the door to surprising power shifts and new strategies.

  • 30+ Unique Units with Progression and Abilities

Collect and upgrade over 30 unique units, each with distinct stats, roles, and upgrade paths. Build the perfect team to suit your playstyle and counter any threat.

  • Battle Across Diverse Arenas

    Fight across a variety of dynamic environments, from lush forests to molten lava fields—each map offering different layouts, pacing, and strategic challenges.

Add to Your Wishlist Now!

Don’t miss your chance to be part of the next big event in the tower defense genre! Add ChanceLot TD: Merge Wars to your Steam Wishlist and be among the first to get notified when the game is released.

short_description: A tactical co-op tower defense game with a twist of luck. Summon, merge, spin the wheel, and face endless waves with your friends. Choose your difficulty and prove your team can handle any challenge.
